## 新增

- **原文与译文的字号可以分开调** — 翻译流卡片头部新增 `Aa` 按钮，点开能分别设置原文和译文字号（10–32px）；字幕窗的「字号」也拆成了原文、译文两条滑块（12–72px）。旧配置按原来的比例自动迁移，升级后外观不变。感谢 @saradin1228 贡献（#6）。

## 安装与打开

需要一个 API Key：[阿里云百炼](https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/cn-beijing/model/settings/api-key)、[OpenAI](https://platform.openai.com/api-keys) 或 [Google AI Studio](https://aistudio.google.com/apikey) 任选其一。首次打开后点右上角齿轮，选好接口再填入 Key。

### Windows 10 / 11

1. 下载 [`ReaLingo_0.6.1_x64-setup.exe`](https://github.com/noSugarK/ReaLingo/releases/download/v0.6.1/ReaLingo_0.6.1_x64-setup.exe)（推荐）或 [`ReaLingo_0.6.1_x64_en-US.msi`](https://github.com/noSugarK/ReaLingo/releases/download/v0.6.1/ReaLingo_0.6.1_x64_en-US.msi)，双击安装。
2. 安装包没有代码签名，SmartScreen 可能提示「Windows 已保护你的电脑」：点 **更多信息 → 仍要运行**。
3. 从开始菜单打开 ReaLingo。Windows 11 会把托盘图标折叠进 `^`，想常驻就拖到任务栏上。

### macOS 12+（Intel 与 Apple Silicon 通用）

1. 下载 [`ReaLingo_0.6.1_universal.dmg`](https://github.com/noSugarK/ReaLingo/releases/download/v0.6.1/ReaLingo_0.6.1_universal.dmg)，打开后把 ReaLingo 拖进「应用程序」。
2. 应用没有经过 Apple 公证，首次打开会被拦下（提示「已损坏」或「无法验证开发者」）。在终端执行一次：
   ```bash
   xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/ReaLingo.app
   ```
   或者先打开一次，再到 **系统设置 → 隐私与安全性**，在页面下方点 **仍要打开**。
3. 首次用麦克风 / 系统声音时会弹权限申请，点允许。系统声音需要 **macOS 14.4+**。

### Linux（Ubuntu 22.04+）

1. 下载 [`ReaLingo_0.6.1_amd64.deb`](https://github.com/noSugarK/ReaLingo/releases/download/v0.6.1/ReaLingo_0.6.1_amd64.deb)，用 apt 安装（会自动拉依赖，`dpkg -i` 不会）：
   ```bash
   sudo apt install ./ReaLingo_0.6.1_amd64.deb
   ```
2. 从应用菜单打开 ReaLingo，或在终端运行 `realingo`。
3. 系统声音需要 PulseAudio 或 PipeWire（Ubuntu 桌面默认就有）。托盘图标不响应左键，用右键菜单里的「显示主窗口」。

## New

- **Source and translation sizes are now separate** — an `Aa` button in the translation stream's header sets each row's font size (10–32px), and the overlay's single "Font size" is now two sliders (12–72px). An existing config migrates at the old ratio, so nothing looks different after the upgrade. Thanks to @saradin1228 for the contribution (#6).

## Install

You need an API key from [Alibaba Cloud Model Studio](https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/ap-southeast-1/model/settings/api-key), [OpenAI](https://platform.openai.com/api-keys) or [Google AI Studio](https://aistudio.google.com/apikey). On first launch, click the gear in the top-right, pick the API and paste the key.

### Windows 10 / 11

1. Download [`ReaLingo_0.6.1_x64-setup.exe`](https://github.com/noSugarK/ReaLingo/releases/download/v0.6.1/ReaLingo_0.6.1_x64-setup.exe) (recommended) or [`ReaLingo_0.6.1_x64_en-US.msi`](https://github.com/noSugarK/ReaLingo/releases/download/v0.6.1/ReaLingo_0.6.1_x64_en-US.msi) and run it.
2. The installer is not code-signed, so SmartScreen may say "Windows protected your PC": click **More info → Run anyway**.
3. Open ReaLingo from the Start menu. Windows 11 folds new tray icons under `^`; drag it onto the taskbar to keep it visible.

### macOS 12+ (universal: Intel and Apple Silicon)

1. Download [`ReaLingo_0.6.1_universal.dmg`](https://github.com/noSugarK/ReaLingo/releases/download/v0.6.1/ReaLingo_0.6.1_universal.dmg), open it and drag ReaLingo into Applications.
2. The app is not notarised, so the first launch is blocked ("damaged" or "unidentified developer"). Run once in Terminal:
   ```bash
   xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/ReaLingo.app
   ```
   or open it once, then click **Open Anyway** at the bottom of **System Settings → Privacy & Security**.
3. Allow the microphone / system audio permission when asked. System audio needs **macOS 14.4+**.

### Linux (Ubuntu 22.04+)

1. Download [`ReaLingo_0.6.1_amd64.deb`](https://github.com/noSugarK/ReaLingo/releases/download/v0.6.1/ReaLingo_0.6.1_amd64.deb) and install it with apt (which pulls in dependencies; `dpkg -i` does not):
   ```bash
   sudo apt install ./ReaLingo_0.6.1_amd64.deb
   ```
2. Open ReaLingo from the app menu, or run `realingo` in a terminal.
3. System audio needs PulseAudio or PipeWire (standard on the Ubuntu desktop). The tray icon ignores left clicks; use "Show main window" in its right-click menu.
